## 2026

### 2026 · Papers in print

- **Kremer, P.**, Borowiak, C., Scolio, M. (2026). Building protective data infrastructure for urban community gardens: Lessons from the Philadelphia Garden Data Collaborative. *Journal of Agriculture, Food Systems, and Community Development*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.5304/jafscd.2026.154.017)

### Nov 2026 · Community Land Leadership Cohort panel
Invited panelist on *Financing, Data, and Storytelling: Making the Case for Community Land* at the Philadelphia and Camden Community Land Leadership Cohort convening (Open Space Institute, with Just Strategies and the William Penn Foundation), The Discovery Center, November 12, speaking on how mapping and property data help protect community gardens.

- Sanders, **Kremer**, Coonfield, Smith, Gandy, Arabi. *An Observational Analysis of Human Activity, Physical Conditions, and Social Context Around Green Stormwater Infrastructure Sites in Kensington, Philadelphia*.
- Wildonger, Goldsmith, Good, **Kremer**, Smith. *Heavy Metal Transport and Bioavailability Across Particle Size Fractions in Green Stormwater Infrastructure Receiving Highway Runoff*.
